event: 2026 ILCA 4 Youth European Championship and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Javier Blanco (CRO).
Noah Lee, Dewi Couvert, Asis Herrerias, Daniel Cardona (Coaches) and Pablo, Jorge, Jean-Bernard, Qun Zhao (jury members) attended the hearing as observers.
Hearings No. 9, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16 and 17 were heard together with hearing No. 7 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since all hearings arose from the same or very closely connected incidents.
facts: During race 4 of the ILCA 4 (Boys) (Yellow, Blue and Red fleets), the wind dropped considerably and there was also a considerable wind shift to the right side of the course, in race area A.
The race committee was aware of the wind changes, but considered that it did not affect the fairness of the competition.
The race was was allowed to progress and all boats that finished were scored according to their finishing places.
conclusions: Allowing the race to progress was not an improper action of the race committee.
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
